info.title: id-proto-debugger API
info.description:
The id-proto-debugger api: a guarded proxy and relay for the protocol
workflows a browser cannot complete on its own. Every endpoint that
connects anywhere does so to a target its caller names, under the address
policy, timeouts and caps of the api's configuration.

ModelRefusal.description:
The validator's own refusal: the body was not the JSON shape this
operation takes. `code` is always EMODELREQUEST, and `error` names the
member and what was wrong with it.

Otp.HttpExchange.description: The outbound request and its answer, when http_trace asked for it.

Otp.Limits.description: What /otp/verify will send, and to which servers.

Otp.Unreachable.description: The verifier could not be reached. `code` is the network's, or empty.

Otp.VerifyAnswer.description:
What the verifier said. `ok` is the HTTP status being 2xx and nothing
more: the protocol's own status=OK or BAD_OTP is inside `body`, which the
page reads and checks against its nonce and the API key.

body.description:
The signed fields, form-encoded: id, otp, nonce and h, and optionally
sl, timeout and timestamp. Sent as the GET's query string, unchanged.
body.x-checked-in-code: api/otp_verify.js: present, no line break, at most 2048 bytes, a form of only the seven Validation Protocol 2.0 fields, with a digit client id, a 32-48 character modhex OTP, a 16-40 character nonce and a base64 h

verifier.description: A verifier URL of the caller's own. Wins over `server`.
verifier.x-checked-in-code: api/otp_verify.js: an https URL with no userinfo, query string or '..'; the address policy installed on axios decides where it may go

server.description: Which YubiCloud server, 1 to 5, when no verifier is named.
server.x-checked-in-code: api/otp_verify.js: an integer 1 to 5, as a number or as text; absent or empty is 1

sslValidate.description: Only false (or "false") turns off certificate verification.

http_trace.description: true (or "true") attaches the outbound exchange as http_exchange.

Otp.VerifyRequest.description: A validation request the page already signed, and where to send it.

Refusal.description:
A request this service refused, or a call it could not complete. `error`
is a sentence for a person; `code`, where the endpoint has one, is the
stable name a caller branches on.

Service.ModelGap.description:
One answer that did not match its operation's response schema. Recorded
only where `validateResponses` is on, which is a test configuration; the
answer itself was sent unchanged. No member value is recorded, only where
the schema and the answer disagreed, because an answer can carry a token.

Service.ModelGaps.description: Every recorded gap since the process started.
